evidence.reason: Line 855 mutates the live config (`git restore -- CONFIG`) before the recovery block starts at line 856. The function's own comment at lines 842-846 says the live bytes are backed up and “reinstalled if the switch fails,” and the recovery handler catches `BaseException`, including interrupts. An interrupt or failure during/after the restore but before entering the `try` leaves HEAD on `previous` while the live config has been reset to committed bytes, losing host overrides; only the backup remains. The smallest compatible fix is to include the restore inside recovery (or enter recovery first) and reinstall `current` when HEAD has not moved, while keeping restore before checkout on the success path.
